sys_properties.description: sys_id of the "ITF Department Routing" sys_decision decision table. The table is authored in app source: the parent sys_decision in itf-decision-tables.now.ts and its input, outputs, questions, answers and answer values in itf-decision-table-rows.now.ts. The value above is the build-generated key for dt_department_routing in src/fluent/generated/keys.ts, so it is stable across builds and installs. (The earlier claim that Fluent has no Decision Table API and the table had to be hand-built in the UI is disproven - there is no dedicated API, but Record() authors all five record types.)
